_comment: Copy to brand/cobrand/partner.json in a new microsite and fill in. The boilerplate itself never has a partner.json; its presence marks a repo as a cobranded microsite. Rules: brand/rl/COBRAND-RULES.md.

partner.name: Partner Name
partner.programme: One-line description of the shared programme, e.g. 'Polo Ralph Lauren Spring 2027 wholesale launch'
partner.audience: Who the microsite serves, e.g. 'partner buyers and store teams'

source.notes: For url: captured with a quick Stardust extract of the partner site (see AGENTS.md). For brand-kit: values supplied by the partner.
